content_zh:
巡夜士兵吓的丢了灯笼，连滚带爬的逃回军营上报伍长。
伍长和士兵一起，提了长刀，挑着灯，出营查看。
两人放眼望去，只见瓢泼大雨中，有一道身影静静坐在死尸堆中。
伍长打着灯笼遥遥一照，却见是一名士兵，穿着残破的制式皮甲，倚靠在一堆头颅上，背对着灯火。
伍长握紧长刀，沉声问：“前面是何人？”
隔着雨幕，只听一道模糊的声音传来：“在下前锋营士兵，受了重伤，身子动不了。”
动不了？
伍长神色一缓，拎刀上前道：“原来是前锋营的兄弟，来，我扶你起来。”
“多谢。”
“不客气，去死。”
长刀破开雨幕，化作一道冷芒，直往那人脖颈砍去。
伍长这一刀凶狠无比，又算准了时机，那人的头颅直接被砍掉，滚落到尸坑深处。
一刀了账！
伍长狞笑着收回长刀，忽然脸色一变：“什——”
一道身影从那人身下的尸堆冲天而起，手中的冷厉寒光抹过伍长的手臂。
手臂连同长刀被斩飞出去，一蓬血雾从断臂处爆开，在疾风夜雨中散落不见。
剧痛传来，伍长脸上露出难以置信之色，瞳孔中倒映出一道高高跃起的身影。
一把短剑在伍长眼前放大。
扑的一声，短剑刺入眼眶。
剧痛只持续了短暂的一瞬间，然后是一片漆黑。

数息之后。
少年将短剑从伍长眼眶拔出来。
伍长的尸体直挺挺向后倒下去，摔在泥泞中。
少年握着短剑，默默站在原地。
夜雨噼里啪啦打下来，少年脸上的泥水被冲刷掉，露出一双明亮的眼睛。
忽然，少年的眼神变得锐利。
在他脚下，伍长的肚子猛地鼓胀起来，肚皮内发出一阵诡异的咕咕声。
少年深吸了口气，双手握剑，照着伍长的肚子全力刺进去。
一声非人的惨叫传来，伍长肚子上喷出一层黑雾，肚皮下起伏不定，似有什么东西在拼命挣扎。
哗啦一声，伍长的肚皮破开，一只漆黑枯瘦的爪子伸了出来。
还不等这恐怖的鬼爪有何动作，少年双手握着剑柄猛力一绞。
“死！”
少年吐出一个字。
疯狂扭动的尸体突然僵住，那只鬼爪也不甘的缓缓垂落下去，不再做出任何动作。
一切归于寂静。
腥臭的黑血，从伍长尸体下面缓缓扩散开来。
见了这层黑血，少年才微微松口气，用力拔出短剑。
他垂头看着地上的诡异尸体，低声喃喃自语。
“这么奇怪的情景，不知道任务奖励会是什么？”
少年带着三分期待，轻喝道：“系统！”

一息，两息，三息。
时间静静流逝，但什么也没有发生。
黑夜中，只有风吹雨落之声绵绵不绝于耳。
少年意外的歪了歪脑袋，来回望了一圈儿——背后是死人坑，脚下是魔头尸体，前面不远处，一名士兵吓的瘫软在地上，连嘴唇都在发抖。
“奇怪。”
少年困惑道：“任务还没完成？”
系统保持着沉默，说明任务并未完成。
少年望着那名士兵，忽然觉得有什么事情被自己忽略了。
少年想了想，吃力的往前挪动脚步，却差点跌倒在泥地里。
刚才集中心神斩杀魔头，一时不觉得，现在缓过劲来，便发觉身上处处都疼，简直疼的要命。
两条腿像灌了铅似的，每挪动一步，都需要用尽全力。
这很不对劲。
末日来临的那一刻，自己用尽全力斩杀了最终魔主，结果却没退出游戏，反倒是带着一身的伤痛，进入到这个莫名其妙的地方。
这到底是哪儿？
少年皱着眉，蹒跚着来到士兵面前，行了个军礼。
“骁骑营，顾青山前来报道。”
“你、你、你杀了上官！”士兵结结巴巴道。
“他不是人。”顾青山打量着士兵，口中说道。
士兵穿着古老的制式皮甲，这种皮甲连灵力驱动装置都没有——就算再怎么不受重视的部队，也不会穿这种古董玩意儿。
顾青山看了看自己身上，居然也是一身的老古董，原本的那些装备都已不翼而飞。

这就奇怪了。
士兵飞快的朝死人坑撇了一眼，伍长那怪异的尸体一动不动的还躺在泥泞中。
士兵犹疑道：“可是……可是你杀他的时候，怎么知道他不是人？”
顾青山摊手道：“我只是小心了一些，他就先动了手。”
顾青山又走回去，将伍长尸体拖到士兵面前，让士兵仔细查看。

content_en:
The night patrol soldier was so frightened that he threw away his lantern and fled back to the barracks to report to the corps commander.
The corps commander and the soldiers went out to check the camp with their long swords and lanterns in hand.
The two of them looked around and saw a figure sitting quietly among the dead bodies in the pouring rain.
The captain held a lantern and looked at it from a distance, only to see a soldier wearing broken standard leather armor, leaning on a pile of heads, with his back to the light.
The captain held the long knife tightly and asked in a deep voice: "Who is in front of you?"
Through the rain curtain, only a vague voice was heard: "This is a soldier from the forward battalion. He is seriously injured and can't move."
Can't move?
The corps commander's expression softened, and he stepped forward with a knife and said: "It turns out you are a brother from the forward battalion. Come here, let me help you up."
"Thank you."
"You're welcome, go to hell."
The long knife broke through the rain curtain and turned into a cold light, slashing straight towards the man's neck.
The captain's knife was extremely ferocious, and he calculated the timing correctly. The man's head was cut off directly and rolled down to the depths of the corpse pit.
Settled with one blow!
Wu Zhang retracted his sword with a ferocious smile, and suddenly his expression changed: "What——"
A figure rose into the sky from the pile of corpses under the man, and the cold light in his hand wiped the captain's arm.
The arm and the long knife were chopped off, and a cloud of blood mist exploded from the broken arm, scattering in the wind and rain.
Severe pain came, and the captain's face showed a look of disbelief, and a figure leaping high was reflected in his pupils.
A short sword magnified in front of the captain's eyes.
With a bang, the dagger pierced his eye socket.
The pain only lasted for a brief moment, and then darkness fell.
After counting the breaths.
The young man pulled the dagger out of the captain's eye socket.
The captain's body fell straight backwards and fell into the mud.
The young man held the dagger and stood silently.
The night rain pattered down, and the mud on the young man's face was washed away, revealing a pair of bright eyes.
Suddenly, the young man's eyes became sharp.
At his feet, the captain's belly suddenly swelled, and there was a strange gurgling sound in his belly.
The young man took a deep breath, held the sword with both hands, and thrust it into the captain's stomach with all his strength.
An inhuman scream came, and a layer of black mist sprayed out from the captain's belly. The belly was heaving, as if something was struggling desperately.
With a crash, the captain's belly opened, and a dark and skinny claw stretched out.
Before the terrifying ghost claw could make any move, the young man grasped the hilt of the sword and twisted it violently.
"Death!"
The boy uttered one word.
The crazily twisting corpse suddenly froze, and the ghost claw reluctantly dropped down slowly, no longer making any movement.
Everything falls silent.
The smelly black blood slowly spread from under the corps commander's body.
Seeing this layer of black blood, the young man breathed a sigh of relief and pulled out the dagger with all his strength.
He lowered his head and looked at the strange corpse on the ground, muttering to himself in a low voice.
"Such a strange scene, I wonder what the mission reward will be?"
The young man shouted with high expectations: "System!"
One breath, two breaths, three breaths.
Time passed quietly, but nothing happened.
In the dark night, only the sound of wind and rain could be heard.
The young man unexpectedly tilted his head and looked around - there was a pit of death behind him, the devil's body was at his feet, and not far in front, a soldier was so frightened that he collapsed on the ground, his lips trembling.
"Strange."
The young man asked in confusion: "The mission is not completed yet?"
The system remained silent, indicating that the task was not completed.
The young man looked at the soldier and suddenly felt that something had been overlooked.
The young man thought for a moment and moved forward with difficulty, but almost fell into the mud.
Just now I concentrated my concentration on killing the demon, and I didn't feel it for a moment. Now that I have calmed down, I find that everywhere in my body hurts, and it hurts like hell.
His legs were like lead, and every step he took required all his strength.
This is very wrong.
At the moment when the end came, I used all my strength to killAfter killing the final demon lord, he did not exit the game. Instead, he entered this inexplicable place with pain all over his body.
Where is this?
The young man frowned, staggered to the soldier, and gave a military salute.
"Xiaoqi Camp, Gu Qingshan is here to report."
"You, you, you killed Shangguan!" the soldier stammered.
"He is not a human being." Gu Qingshan looked at the soldier and said.
The soldiers wore ancient standard leather armor, which did not even have a spiritual drive device - no matter how neglected the troops were, they would not wear such antiques.
Gu Qingshan looked at himself and found that he was also dressed in antiques, and all the original equipment was gone.
This is strange.
The soldier quickly glanced at the death pit, where the corps commander's weird corpse was still lying motionless in the mud.
The soldier hesitated: "But...but when you killed him, how did you know that he was not a human being?"
Gu Qingshan spread his hands and said: "I was just a little more careful, but he made a move first."
Gu Qingshan walked back and dragged the corpse of the corps commander in front of the soldiers so that the soldiers could examine it carefully.
